{"ascii":"ASCII Structure and Anchors: source text -> addressable content
|-- Pin interpretation at the content boundary [diagramContent.ts]
|   |-- buildDiagramContent stores original ASCII, its SHA-256 and caller-supplied revisionId
|   |   `-- Accept printable ASCII + LF, up to 20000 characters
|   |       `-- Empty text rejected; diagram kind permits a multi-row spaces-only rectangle
|   |-- New tree -> ascii-tree-2; new diagram -> ascii-graph-1
|   |-- Stored diagram without parserVersion -> legacy-diagram
|   |   `-- Preserve the derivation used by its saved nodeRefs
|   `-- Rebuild caller passes contentParserVersion(structure)
|       |-- ascii-tree-1 remains supported; incompatible kind/version pairs rejected
|       `-- Version selects interpretation; it is not a document mutation counter
|-- Materialize structure according to content kind
|   |-- Tree -> parse during build; store rootIds and nodes inside DiagramContent
|   |   |-- parseAsciiTree -> shared spatial interpreter [asciiTree.ts]
|   |   |   `-- Tree compatibility profile; zero tolerances; separate continuations; no repairs
|   |   |-- Project source lines into parents, children and descendant lines
|   |   `-- Store foldRanges once for nodes with descendants
|   |       |-- Hide lines after node through line before next peer, or end of text
|   |       |   `-- Next peer has branchColumn <= current node's branchColumn
|   |       `-- visibleContentLines subtracts collapsed ranges from original line numbers
|   |           `-- Unknown collapsed tree ID -> STALE_CONTENT_NODE
|   `-- Diagram -> derive node index on demand [diagramContentNodes.ts]
|       |-- diagramContentNodes returns stored tree nodes or cached diagram nodes
|       |   `-- Diagram cache miss -> derive -> deepFreeze -> WeakMap by content object
|       |-- ascii-graph-1 -> parseAsciiGraph [asciiGraph/parseAsciiGraph.ts]
|       |   |-- Assemble text boxes, multiline spans and containment; resolve wires into edges
|       |   |   `-- Frame borders separate cells and do not carry edges
|       |   `-- Project boxes into content nodes; graph edges remain outside this node index
|       `-- Unversioned diagram -> legacyNodes -> shared spatial interpreter
|           |-- Mixed dialect; separate continuations; no repairs
|           `-- Project nodes with spans, using their first span as the anchor
|-- Hand off content-node identity and geometry to consumers
|   |-- DiagramContentNode supplies labels, IDs and parent/child relationships
|   |   `-- Selection, source mapping and connection endpoints consume these anchors
|   |-- ID scope = caller-supplied revisionId + ASCII hash + parser-derived local identity
|   |   |-- Tree local identity: line-<line>
|   |   |-- Graph local identity: node-<first span line>-<first span column>
|   |   |   `-- Keeps the earlier single-line ID form when boxes carry multiple spans
|   |   `-- Legacy local identity: interpreter node ID
|   |       `-- Reproduction depends on content scope and parser choice; no cross-edit ID promise
|   |-- First-line fields retain the identity anchor
|   |   `-- line/startColumn/endColumn are deprecated as complete multiline geometry
|   `-- Optional lines[] carries one-based, inclusive text spans
|       |-- Graph projection supplies every text span; legacy projection uses only the first
|       |-- Geometry consumers are directed to contentNodeSpans/contentNodeRect
|       `-- Graph and legacy content nodes have empty foldRanges
`-- Shared spatial interpreter retains reasons and source locations
    |-- parseDiagram [interpreter/index.ts] serves tree compatibility and legacy derivation
    |   |-- Pure synchronous parsing; reports spatial-diagram-1
    |   `-- Normalize source -> recognize candidates -> interpret layout -> trees -> wires
    |-- Rich result [interpreter/types.ts] accompanies nodes, edges and regions
    |   |-- Original text + normalized rows + original offsets for normalized columns
    |   |-- Every source line stays addressable, including prose and unknown syntax
    |   `-- SourceSpan uses one-based coordinates and end-exclusive UTF-16 offsets/ends
    |       `-- Legacy content-node projection converts endColumn to an inclusive end
    `-- Interpretation evidence remains in this rich result
        |-- Decisions record rules, reasons, source evidence and repair references
        |-- Repairs describe logical geometry moves; original source is never rewritten
        |-- Unresolved cases retain alternatives; diagnostics retain location and severity
        `-- explainNode(id) returns relevant decisions, repairs and unresolved cases
            `-- Content-node projections expose anchors without carrying this evidence bundle"}
